title: JupyterLite Interactive Demo
text:
Use this interactive Jupyter environment for Python code execution, matplotlib visualizations, and data science work. It supports notebooks, plots, and file management.

 

Getting Started: 1. Click the Python (Pyodide) tile to create a new notebook 2. For quick calculations, you can also use File → New → Console to open a Python console 3. Test with a simple command:
print("Hello from JupyterLite!")
Saving Your Work: - Auto-save: Your notebooks are automatically saved to your browser’s local storage (they persist between visits to this page) - Download: Use File → Download to save a .ipynb file to your computer - Note: Files are stored in your browser only - clearing browser data will delete saved notebooks




# Basic Python
print("Hello from JupyterLite!")
for i in range(5):
    print(f"Number {i}: {i**2}")
# Calculation
import math
radius = 5
area = math.pi * radius ** 2
print(f"Circle area: {area:.2f}")
